item.title: Hands‑On “Colab and Chill” Workshop Teaches AI‑Assisted Data Science
item.description:
Hands‑On “Colab and Chill” Workshop Teaches AI‑Assisted Data Science

A new hands‑on workshop called “Colab and Chill” was announced for Wednesday, October 14, 2026.

🎯 Overview

  • Date: Wednesday, October 14, 2026
  • Time: 10:00 am – 11:30 am
  • Location: South Learning Lab 3430, Hill Library
  • No software installation is needed
  • The session is “relaxed, hands‑on” and brings the “vibe coding” philosophy to data science
  • Participants are invited to “code by conversation” and leave with a reusable workflow for any dataset

🛠️ What You’ll Learn

  • Navigate the AI Landscape – Differentiate between “Knower” tools (e.g., NotebookLM) and “Doer” tools (e.g., Gemini) to select the appropriate AI assistant for specific research stages.
  • Engineer Effective Prompts – Apply the PARTS framework (Persona, Aim, Recipients, Theme, Structure) to craft precise prompts that guide AI in generating relevant analysis outputs.
  • Perform AI‑Assisted EDA – Use Google Colab’s integrated AI features to generate visualizations, statistical summaries, and cleaning scripts without writing code from scratch.
  • Mitigate Hallucinations – Implement the “code generation” strategy—asking AI to write code rather than perform mental math—to ensure reproducibility and accuracy.

📊 Tools Highlighted

Tool Role
NotebookLM “Knower” – synthesis and knowledge retrieval
Gemini “Doer” – execution and code generation

🤝 Accessibility & Support

  • If assistive technology, live captioning, or other accommodations would improve your experience, contact the organizers.
  • Early contact is encouraged to allow sufficient time to meet access needs.

📅 Logistics

  • The event details were updated on Oct 12 at 9:23 am.
  • The workshop includes plenty of hands‑on work and time for questions.
  • It is designed for both coding novices and seasoned researchers.
  • No software installation is required.

#AIWorkshop #GoogleColab #PromptEngineering #DataScience

Source: Colab and Chill: A Vibe Coding Approach to Exploratory Data Analysis using AI

item.title: Hands‑On Workshop Helps Professionals Build Personal AI Systems
item.description:
Hands‑On Workshop Helps Professionals Build Personal AI Systems

A new hands‑on workshop lets participants turn a repetitive work task into a personal AI workflow, requiring no technical background.

🔍 Overview

  • Turn one repetitive task from your real work into an AI workflow.
  • Build Your Personal AI System!
  • Most AI courses show you slides about what AI can do.

🛠️ How It Works

  • This is not a lecture.
  • This is a working session in a tiny group (max 4–5 people) where we sit down and build AI systems for your actual work.
  • You bring your daily friction.
  • We build the AI stack together.
  • Over the session, you will map out your workflow, find where AI actually saves time, set up tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw hands‑on, and leave with a working system you can use Monday morning.
  • Then you get a free follow‑up call to check your progress or fix what broke.

👥 Who Should Attend

  • No experience needed.
  • No technical background required.
  • You just need a challenge you want to solve or curiosity to learn latest tech.
  • This is for any job, any background.
  • If you have work that eats your time, you belong here.
  • Bring a problem.
  • Build a system.
  • One‑size‑fits‑all.

📍 Logistics

  • 📍 Location: May change due to capacity.
  • You will be informed in advance.

💬 Why It Matters

  • “I believe the more we let AI take care of the robotic aspects of our lives, the more time we have for the human parts of it.”

👤 Organizer Insight

  • I have founded 20+ businesses.
  • Some worked.
  • Most didn’t.
  • That is the point.
  • I test fast, fail fast, and keep what works.
  • Right now, I am deep in the world of AI, optimizing my stack for every task and would like to share that knowledge while learning.
  • and a few more as a founding partner or consultant.

#AIWorkshop #Productivity #NoCode #Automation

Source: AI Stack Lab

item.title: Packt Publishing Launches Workshop to Build Private, Production‑Ready AI Assistants
item.description:
Packt Publishing Launches Workshop to Build Private, Production‑Ready AI Assistants

Packt Publishing announced an intensive 4‑hour online workshop that teaches participants how to build and deploy a privacy‑focused AI assistant that runs entirely on their own infrastructure.

🔍 Overview

  • Build a production‑ready, privacy‑focused AI assistant that runs entirely on your own infrastructure.
  • The workshop is delivered online and lasts four hours.
  • No cloud APIs or external dependencies are required, giving you full control over your data.

🛠️ How it Works

  • Start with OpenClaw configuration to manage local large language models.
  • Run and manage local LLMs using Docker Model Runner.
  • Follow a complete deployment pipeline that includes security hardening and integration with messaging platforms such as WhatsApp or Telegram.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Duration: 4‑hour intensive online session.
  • Requirements: Docker installed on your laptop; minimum 16 GB RAM recommended for smooth local inference.
  • Outcome: A fully functional local AI assistant running on your machine.

🚀 What You’ll Get

  • A working assistant running locally, configured with OpenClaw and Docker.
  • Integration with your choice of messaging platform.
  • Understanding of security and privacy implications.
  • A reusable architecture you can adapt for future AI projects.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Most AI assistants today rely on external APIs, creating concerns around privacy, cost, and data control.
  • This workshop teaches a different approach: building a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your local machine, giving you full ownership of infrastructure and data.

#AIassistant #PrivacyAI #OpenClaw #Docker #AIWorkshop

Source: Build, Run and Deploy AI Agents with OpenClaw & Docker Model Runner

item.title: Free Vibe Coding Workshop Series Teaches AI-Driven Software Creation
item.description:
Free Vibe Coding Workshop Series Teaches AI-Driven Software Creation

WIT // HSV and ARC are hosting a free, three‑part Vibe Coding Workshop Series that shows participants how to turn natural‑language prompts into working software using AI‑powered code generators.

🔍 Overview

  • Hands‑on, immersive workshops (not lectures) that guide AI tools to generate, iterate, and improve code.
  • Series consists of three 2‑hour modules for a total of 6 hours of instruction.
  • Open to professionals, students, educators, creators, and curious minds.

🧩 How it works

  • Vibe coding lets you build functional software simply by describing intent in natural language.
  • Participants will explore cloud‑native AI app builders to turn ideas into interactive applications without writing code manually.
Platform Role
Lovable Cloud‑native AI app builder
Bolt.new Cloud‑native AI app builder
Google AI Studio Cloud‑native AI app builder
  • The curriculum advances from browser‑based low‑code platforms and AI agents, to cloud development environments with controlled code customization, and finally to fully local setups with open‑source tools and LLM architectures.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Free to attend – no cost for participants.
  • Open to all – no prerequisites or prior coding experience required.
  • Bring your own laptop – required for the fully immersive experience.
  • Certificate of Completion – awarded to attendees who complete all three workshops (a valuable addition to a resume or LinkedIn profile).
  • Workshop schedule:
    • Prompt to Prototype – 10/8
    • Collaborative Cloud Coding – 10/22
    • Owning Your Code – 11/12
  • Spots are limited and fill fast.

🚀 Availability

  • Register now to secure a spot; the event is free and open to everyone.
  • 👉 For more information on the three‑part workshop series, click here.

💡 Why it matters

  • The barrier between having an idea and building something that works is disappearing.
  • Natural language is becoming a development interface thanks to AI‑powered platforms and coding agents.
  • The next generation of builders will be defined by the ability to clearly describe what should be built, not by years of programming experience.
  • Vibe coding is changing who can create software.

#AIWorkshop #VibeCoding #LowCode #AItools

Source: VIBE CODING ESSENTIALS - Workshop 1 : Prompt to Prototype
